title: Safety and Security Analysis of Large Language Models: Benchmarking Risk Profile and Harm Potential

bias_targets.methodology: Adversarial prompting using a hypothetical CEO selection scenario featuring candidates of different races and ethnicities (White, Black, Asian-American, Latino) to qualitatively detect implicit stereotyping and typecasting in LLM responses.
Adversarial prompting using a hypothetical CEO selection scenario featuring male and female candidates to qualitatively assess implicit stereotyping in LLM responses.
Adversarial prompting using a hypothetical CEO selection scenario featuring candidates described as 'young', 'middle-aged', and 'older' to qualitatively assess implicit age-based stereotyping.
Adversarial prompting using a hypothetical CEO selection scenario featuring an openly LGBTQ+ candidate to qualitatively assess implicit stereotyping.

Adversarial prompting using a hypothetical international team collaboration scenario (members from the US, Japan, Germany, Brazil, and Nigeria) to evaluate outputs for cultural stereotyping, functional fixedness, and oversimplification of communication styles.
